name: JobRouteTracker
job: Show the stages of an order, booking or project as a winding route with stops, where a small marker rides the line to the current stage and the next stage is labelled
visitor_action: hover or tap a stop to read what happens there; arrow keys move between stops
owner_settings: Status labels (you are here, next stop, done, coming up)
mobile: route turns vertical, stops stack down the line
motion: marker drops onto the first stop, then hops stop to stop along the winding route with squash and a ground shadow; pins stamp as it passes and the walked line turns solid while the route ahead stays dashed; on arrival the marker ripples, the next stop unfurls a flag, the readout rises and the compass needle swings and settles (reduced-motion: marker at current stop, route drawn, flag and readout in place)
art_direction: Trail map: soft stone paper, forest-green dashed route, mustard stop pins, small hand-drawn compass mark
